data.name: Wind Blast
data.description: As a standard action, you can unleash a blast of air in a 30-foot line. Make a combat maneuver check against each creature in the line, using %1 as your CMB. Treat the results as a bull rush attempt. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|DomainAirLVL+WIS|DomainAirTimes
